messages:
Diego: Quick heads-up 4: publishing updated handbook language for benefits (401k tiers, parental leave payout examples, statutory sick pay clarifications). Need localization checks + manager ack flow. Office hours tomorrow 11:00am PT. Drop blockers here.

Ivy: Added two edge cases in the tracker: partial-year hires and contractors. @Liam please check contractor eligibility language  eng flagged ambiguity.

Liam: Will avoid 'cliff' wording. Suggest: 'eligibility begins after 90 days of continuous service unless local law provides otherwise.' Ill add inline edits by EOD.

Sora: Localization note: EU and some APAC markets require explicit statutory sick pay text and different accrual formulas. Adding per-country rows in the sheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ExampleLink (internal)

Priya: Managers must ACK changes by next Friday. Ill export manager roster and schedule reminders + manager packet email at 4:00pm PT today.

Kai: Training plan: 20-min microlearning + 5-question quiz (80% pass). I'll record once and publish two windows. Will add captions.

Diego: For tracking use columns: manager_ack_ts, localization_tag, training_assigned. Priya  include relocation flag so relocating hires get mandatory assignment.

Liam: Legal asks: 1) replace 'benefits cliff' with 90-day eligibility and note statutory overrides; 2) clarify PTO carryover vs local law with examples for CA/UK/DE; 3) short clause on contractor classification. Comments incoming.

Ivy: Draft manager comms (paste edits welcome):

``
Hi managers,
Were updating handbook sections on benefits (401k, parental leave, sick pay, eligibility). Please review the manager packet and acknowledge by Friday EOD. Packet: <sheet link>
Thanks, Ivy
``

Diego: Add short note about training credits and how to book vendor sessions. Priya  please add booking steps to the packet.

Priya: Done  added training credits blurb and booking workflow. Sending packet at 16:00 PT.

Sora: Scheduling two live office hours (11:00am PT, 11:00am SGT) + will publish recording and a one-page FAQ for local HR partners.

Diego: Action list: Liam  legal edits by EOD; Priya  manager export + reminders at 16:00; Sora  add localization rows + schedule office hours; Kai  record microlearning + quiz; Ivy  finalize manager comms in sheet. Ill host office hours tomorrow 11:00am PT. :thumbsup:

Ivy: Ack.

Liam: Will comment in doc.

Priya: Packet scheduled.

Kai: Recording scheduled, will upload to sheet.

Diego: Closing for now. If blockers appear, drop them here and Ill escalate.

Sora: See you tomorrow at 11:00am PT.
